{{Top|leg}}
'''Lergo''' was a vehicle manufacturing company that was active during the era of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. It eventually merged with [[Minas]] to become [[Minas-Lergo]].
